title: Local dev environment: compose stack, seed data, one-command up
goal: `pnpm dev:up` starts Postgres, Redis, an S3-compatible store and a mail catcher locally, migrates and seeds them, and prints the URLs.
scope_in: docker-compose file with postgres:16, redis:7, minio (S3 API, stands in for R2) and mailpit, named volumes, health checks, ports bound to 127.0.0.1 only.
tools/dev/up.sh and tools/dev/down.sh: start stack, wait for health, run `centcom-db migrate`, run seed, write a git-ignored `.env.local` from `.env.example` names.

Seed script creating deterministic dev data: 3 users (owner, member, guest), 1 workspace `acme-dev`, memberships with each of those workspace roles, 2 devices with fixed test keys, 1 paused session; ids fixed so docs and tests can refer to them.
docs/dev-environment.md: ports, URLs, reset instructions, how to run the API against the stack.
scope_out: Production infra, Terraform, Fly config (infra lanes).
build_against: Docker or Podman compose only; no cloud services, no network after image pull.
interfaces: Local endpoints: Postgres `127.0.0.1:5432`, Redis `127.0.0.1:6379`, MinIO API `127.0.0.1:9000` console `9001`, Mailpit SMTP `1025` UI `8025`.
Seed constants exported from tools/dev/seed.ts: `SEED.users.owner.id`, `SEED.workspace.id`, etc.
acceptance: On a clean machine with Docker, `pnpm dev:up` reaches all services healthy and exits 0 within 90 s (images cached).
After `dev:up`, the users table has exactly 3 rows, memberships has 3 with roles owner, member, guest, and migrations are at the latest version.
Running `dev:up` twice is idempotent: no duplicate seed rows, no errors.
`dev:reset` wipes volumes and brings the stack back to the seeded state.
All published ports are bound to 127.0.0.1 (verified from `docker compose config`).
The seeded device keys are documented as test-only and are not valid on any non-dev config.
`.env.local` is created only if missing and is listed in .gitignore.
tests: seed.test.ts: seed runs twice against a B010 test stack, counts stable.
compose-lint: `docker compose config -q` passes in CI.
smoke script test (optional, CI-only): up, health checks of services, down.
guardrails: MUST bind every container port to 127.0.0.1, never 0.0.0.0.
MUST NOT include any value usable in staging/production (fixed dev passwords are `dev-only` and the seed refuses to run when NODE_ENV=production).
MUST NOT embed real third-party API keys; Stripe/Postmark/OAuth are stubbed or absent in dev.
MUST NOT let the seed run against a database not named like `centcom_dev` or `test_*`.
failure_modes: Port already in use -> script prints which port and the override env var instead of failing opaquely.
Health check not green in 90 s -> script prints the failing service's last 50 log lines and exits 1.
Seed fails midway -> transaction rollback; rerun is safe.
notes: Root package.json scripts dev:up etc. are defined by B001 and call these files. .env.local generation reads names from the .env.example delivered by B004.
